subject: Self-billing reconciliation exception — reverse-charge handling and VAT ID mismatch
messages:
From: Ewa Kowalska <ewa.k@starlight.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@starlight.io
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Discrepancy on Dec invoice - reverse charge applied incorrectly

Hi Ben,

Our finance team ran the monthly reconciliation and flagged an issue with Redwood invoice #R-2026-12-447 (attached). The invoice shows a 0% VAT with a reverse-charge note, but our VAT ID on file (PL999888777) is not being accepted by your billing system — the invoice was self-billed and ended up posted to our books as output VAT instead of reverse-charge.

Can you confirm:
- Why did Redwood self-bill rather than issue a standard supplier invoice?
- Whether you validated our VAT ID before generating the invoice?
- If you can reissue the invoice under reverse-charge so our accounting team can avoid a VAT liability mismatch.

I've attached the invoice PDF and our VAT registration certificate for quick reference. We're on a tight close for the quarter; would appreciate confirmation by EOD tomorrow (Mon 11 Jan).

Thanks,
Ewa Kowalska
Head of Finance — Starlight Systems
ewa.k@starlight.io | +48 22 555 0123

Attachments: starlight-invoice-2026-12.pdf (application/pdf), starlight-vat-cert-2026.pdf (application/pdf)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Ewa Kowalska <ewa.k@starlight.io>
Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Dec invoice - reverse charge applied incorrectly

Ewa — thanks for raising this and for the docs.

Short answer: we should be able to fix this as a reissued self-billed invoice with the reverse-charge note corrected, but I need billing ops to confirm what happened in our generation pipeline.

@Soojin / @Markus: can one of you check the invoice generation logs for R-2026-12-447? Specifically:
- Was the VAT ID validated at invoice time, and if so, which validation source (VIES / manual)?
- Did the account have self-billing enabled or was this routed through marketplace self-bill logic?
- If it was an automated self-bill, can we issue a corrected invoice (credit + reissue) with reverse-charge language and reference to Starlight's VAT ID?

Ewa, I will escalate to get this turned around quickly — aim is to have a corrected invoice and a short note confirming method of validation by Tue 12 Jan EOD CET.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

> Our finance team ran the monthly reconciliation and flagged an issue with Redwood invoice #R-2026-12-447 (attached).

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Ewa Kowalska <ewa.k@starlight.io>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Dec invoice - reverse charge applied incorrectly

Ben / Markus — looked into the ledger and validation logs. Summary:

- VAT validation: the VAT ID PL999888777 successfully passed a VIES check at 2026-12-30T17:08:43Z (response: valid). The validation token was recorded in our billing metadata.
- Self-billing path: invoice R-2026-12-447 was generated by our self-billing service because Starlight had the marketplace self-billing flag set (merchant_integration: true). That service currently emits "self-billed" invoices that are intended to include reverse-charge language when a valid EU VAT ID is present, but a recent rules change in the templating engine suppressed the reverse-charge clause for marketplace-generated docs — bug 2026-11-ops-317.
- Impact: document shows 0% VAT but lacks explicit reverse-charge text; accounting systems that rely on the textual clause treated it as supplier-issued 0% VAT (output VAT).

Remediation plan (ETA):
1) Issue credit for R-2026-12-447 and reissue corrected self-billed invoice R-2026-12-447-C (includes reverse-charge note and VAT ID). Owner: Markus. Target: Tue 12 Jan 17:00 CET.
2) Short confirmation email to Starlight finance documenting VIES validation timestamp and remediation steps. Owner: Ben. Target: Tue 12 Jan 18:00 CET.
3) Template regression patch to self-billing service to always include reverse-charge when VIES=true and billing_country != supplier_country. Owner: Engineering (ops ticket created). ETA: 2027-01-20.

Markus — please confirm you can create the credit & reissue by 17:00 CET and attach the corrected PDF here.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

---
On Mon, Jan 11, 2027 at 09:22 AM ben_carter@redwood.ai wrote:

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Ewa Kowalska <ewa.k@starlight.io>, finance@starlight.io
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 16:45:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Dec invoice - reverse charge applied incorrectly

All — credit issued and corrected invoice attached. Summary below:

- Credit note: CN-2026-12-447 (amount: EUR 18,450.00) issued to reverse the original self-billed record.
- Reissued invoice: R-2026-12-447-C (attached PDF) — includes the explicit reverse-charge statement, Starlight VAT ID (PL999888777), and VIES validation timestamp (2026-12-30T17:08:43Z).
- Internal note: flagged previous template regression (2026-11-ops-317) as blocked for any further self-billing runs until patch deploy.

Ewa — apologies for the noise. Please confirm that the reissued invoice meets your requirements and whether you need any additional attestations for your ledger team. If all good, we'll close the ticket and add a post-mortem to the billing runbook.

Markus Klein
Billing Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: R-2026-12-447-C.pdf (application/pdf), CN-2026-12-447.pdf (application/pdf)
